description: A named group of navigation items, rendered by TmSidebar under one visible heading that also names the group's list through aria-labelledby.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Heading text of the group. Rendered as the section heading and used as the accessible name of the group's list — keep it short ("Main", "Administration").

properties.name: Items
properties.description: Items of the group, in display order.
